important: G1-NOR-094 4Ω is stated in I7 §5.5.7.11 with 'poate fi' and earth protection requires disconnection per §5.5.7.10; not an absolute electrical safety guarantee. G1-NOR-088 uses §4.1.5.3.8.
method: Same-assistant source, linguistic and counterexamples. No independent QA or learner approval.
